Meta.description: Faɗa wa Najimi abin da kake so. Yana ƙirƙirar abin da ya dace da rayuwarka — sabon hasken ɗakinka, abincin dare ga mahaifiyarka, littafinka na gaba — tare da nuna bayanan Qloo da suka jagoranci kowane zaɓi.

Landing.kicker: An gina bisa AI na Qloo mai fahimtar zaɓi
Landing.title: Abokin zaɓin abin so.
Landing.lede: Faɗa wa Najimi abubuwa uku da kake so. Yana gano zaɓinka ta Qloo, sannan ya tsara maka abubuwan rayuwa da suka dace da kai: sabon haske a ɗakinka, abincin dare ga mahaifiyarka, littafinka na gaba, daren shaƙatawa a gida. Kowane zaɓi yana nuna bayanan Qloo da aka dogara da su.
Landing.seeWorkflows: Ga abin da zai iya yi
Landing.howLede: Abin da kake so ba rukuni ɗaya ba ne. Qloo na haɗa abubuwan da kake so a kiɗa, fina-finai, littattafai, wurare da samfura; Najimi na mayar da su abubuwan amfani.

love.title: Faɗi abin da kake so
love.body: Abubuwa uku ko fiye: littafi, mawaƙi, shiri, wuri. Faɗi muhimmancin kowanne.

read.title: Qloo na fahimtar zaɓinka
read.body: Kalmomin da ke bayyana zaɓinka (salon kyau, yanayi, abinci) da zaɓuɓɓuka daga fannoni goma, kai tsaye, tare da dalilin kowanne.

make.title: Najimi na sa ya zama gaske
make.body: Sabon salo ga hotunanka, tsare-tsaren fitilu da mai lantarki zai girka, samfuran gaske, girke-girke masu laushi ko taurin da ya dace, jerin waƙoƙi, wurare.

Landing.proof: Kwatanta kowace amsa da ta tambayar nan ba tare da la’akari da zaɓinka ba: Qloo ne bambancin.
Landing.footer: Najimi, an ƙera don hackathon na Qloo.
